high_level_description: The image depicts a fashion runway scene from the Versace Spring/Summer 2019 collection. The model is walking down the runway, showcasing a stylish outfit that combines sportswear-inspired elements with a touch of luxury. Model: The model has curly hair and is wearing a blue jacket with yellow piping on the shoulders and sleeves. Underneath the jacket, there is a patterned shirt and a tie. The model also wears dark jeans with leather patches on the knees and thighs, adding a rugged yet fashionable look. The jeans have a chain accessory hanging from one of the pockets.
